title: Extremal Exchangeability Beyond Natural Noncommutative Products
exact_target: Analyze extremality for free and Boolean independence, seek further examples, and compare extremal exchangeability with a trivial tail algebra.

status_qualification: The curated statement speaks of replacing extremal shift-invariance by shift-invariance with a trivial tail. The primary item (5) actually says extremal S_infinity-invariance and S_infinity-invariance with trivial tail field, meaning exchangeability, not mere shift invariance. These conditions differ and are recorded separately rather than silently conflated.
